title: ControllerData - request  (firmware -> POST /api/ControllerData)
description: Roadmap #343. A JSON ARRAY, one entry per RelayFunction whose on/off state actually CHANGED - sent immediately on the transition, unlike SensorData's fixed polling interval. Several entries can ride in one call when more than one relay changes in the same evaluation tick. Universal: a real device pushes this next to flipping the physical relay, a simulated one pushes it next to its calculated equivalent - the server stores/serves both identically (api.Dal.Entities.ControllerDataRow is upserted per (deviceID, relayFunction), not appended). There is no response body beyond HTTP 200. Credentials travel as HTTP HEADERS: 'apiId' and 'Authorization' (apiAuth token from POST /api/Device/Authenticate) - same rule as POST /api/SensorData.

relayFunction.description: 1=Ventilation, 2=Light, 3=Heating, 4=WaterPump (api.Models.RelayFunction) - same convention as deviceFarmUnitZoneRule.relayFunction in config.response.schema.json.

isOn.description: The relay's new state after this transition.

dateCreated.description: Firmware-side timestamp of the transition; null when the clock is not yet set, in which case the server stamps its own UTC clock instead (api.Dal.EfRepository.ControllerDataPushAsync).
